senses.definition: The moment each evening when the sun disappears below the western horizon.

quotes.text:
’Twas sunset: when the sun will part
There comes a sullenness of heart
To him who still would look upon
The glory of the summer sun.
quotes.reference: 1829, Edgar Allan Poe, “Tamerlane”, in Al Aaraaf, Tamerlane and Minor Poems:

senses.definition: The changes in color of the sky before and after sunset.
(figuratively) The final period of the life of a person or thing.

quotes.text: 'Tis the sunset of life gives me mystical lore.

examples: The tax increase legislation included a sunset clause requiring renewal to prevent the tax increase from expiring.

senses.definition: The region where the sun sets; the west.

examples: We’ll be sunsetting version 1.9 of the software shortly after releasing version 2.0 next quarter.

quotes.text: Last December, Yahoo announced plans to “sunset” more well-known services, including the pioneering social bookmarking service del.icio.us.
quotes.reference: 2011 April 19, Sumit Paul-Choudhury, “Digital legacy: The fate of your online soul”, in NewScientist:

quotes.text: Here’s what you need to know about Amazon’s decision to sunset its older e-readers and tablets, and what that means for you.
